decision.title: Lowering XQuery expressions: FLWOR, typeswitch, switch, try/catch (packet )

body.p: , completing for these kinds. src/xquery_lower.c is lowering part xquery (SXML_LANGUAGE_XQUERY only, ); no IR kind added. Contract in src/xquery_lower_internal.h.

item.p: FLWOR replaces the core's FLWOR for XQuery. Clauses between two tuple stream clauses are a clause segment: for = MAP (position slot, ALLOWING_EMPTY), let = LET (destructuring as ), where = CONDITIONAL, one frame per binding or clause. A segment ending at a tuple stream clause returns tuple arrays (one member per live slot variable, innermost of each name; constants and globals are not packed); then order by = SORT with each key lowered over the members unpacked from the SORT's focus, count = the position slot of the unpacking MAP, while = fn:take-while with a closure fn($tuple, $position) { boolean(C) } (no condition evaluated after the first false). The closure captures every visible variable the condition references (overcapture is harmless) and, only when lowering it read the focus, the FLWOR's focus parts (three slots kept after the captures, bound by LETs at the closure's start). A MAP over the result unpacks the members with LOOKUP before the next segment.

order by: empty least unless written (the prolog default is 3.10's); collation literals resolved against the static base URI; codepoint is NONE, html-ascii-case-insensitive and UCA URIs are kept (the evaluator's SORT still raises FOCH0002 for them, Proposed), anything else is XQST0076. "stable" changes nothing (SORT is stable).
trace clause: lowered (static errors stand) as the never-taken branch of a CONDITIONAL; trace output is implementation-defined and its errors must not fail the FLWOR (4.13.10).

typeswitch: operand once; CONDITIONAL chain over INSTANCE_OF (a union case is a CONDITIONAL of the type tests); case variables bound to the operand. switch: switch value = coerce(fn:data(comparand), xs:anyAtomicType?) or true(); a case operand matches when its atomized value is empty and the switch value is, or some item is fn:deep-equal to it; each case's tests sit in the previous case's else branch (2.6.5).

try/catch: TRY_CATCH (, ); unprefixed error names use the default element namespace; $err: variables the handler references are LOOKUPs of the details slot, $err:map the slot, stack-trace and additional ().

ordered/unordered: their content. Extension expressions: pragma names must resolve (XPST0081); every pragma is ignored; none and no expression is XQST0079. validate: XQST0075 (). String constructors: fn:string-join of the parts, interpolations string-join(E, " ").

Entry points sxml_xquery_lower / sxml_xquery_compile (internal, for tests and drivers until 3.12): a main module without prolog declarations (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE otherwise, 3.10). Group by and the windows are UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE; 3.8 adds them as tuple stream clauses in finish_segment (the tuple layout is in the FLWOR frame's locals).

Measured with a scratch harness (the QT4 driver with the XPath API compiling through sxml_xquery_compile), XQ40: every failure left in prod-ForClause, LetClause, WhereClause, OrderByClause, CountClause, WhileClause, TypeswitchExpr, SwitchExpr, ExtensionExpr, StringConstructor is a node constructor (3.9) or a prolog (3.10), but for three (fn:message missing, local: undeclared, one driver assertion).
